Should add prerequisite: '[contact TBD]: Before requesting Oliver champion internally, confirm he has stakeholder relationships and organizational credibility to drive decision.' While carry-forward is correct given cumulative context, the analysis should explicitly state for each component: 'Recent call unintelligible - no new data - carry-forward based entirely on prior call evidence (call count: 13)' to demonstrate awareness that no validation occurred. Current phrasing implies assessment was made in this call when it was not.
